mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate investments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering corporate earnings revisions downward and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 105 (INDPRO > 105) signals easing supply constraints and rising capacity utilization, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 3.0% (GDPC1 > 18500) signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll employment declining below 140,000 thousand persons (PAYEMS < 140000) signals weakening labor demand, triggering corporate hiring freezes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS < 140000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) and federal funds rate above 0.5% (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signal active monetary tightening, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through higher real rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1600 thousand units (HOUST > 1600) signals strong residential construction activity, boosting related sectors and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sectoral earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1600, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
